request: Build a tower defense game in a single HTML file. A fixed path winds across a tile grid, waves of enemies follow it while the player builds gun, frost, and cannon towers on grass tiles for gold, towers acquire and shoot the nearest enemy in range, cannon shots splash damage, frost towers slow targets, enemies have HP shown as bars, leaking enemies cost lives, waves get harder with more and tougher enemies and reward gold on clear, ending in a death screen with the final score.
